en: Sepia-toned historic view of a cobblestoned square with people walking and children standing in front of a long, two‑storey building with a tiled mansard roof and dormer windows. Large German words are painted on the facade, including 'Schützenhaus.' and other text advertising halls, concerts and a garden. Additional multi‑storey townhouses line the left side. At the top of the image are printed captions reading 'Torgau a. Elbe.' and 'Paradeplatz.' indicating the location.
